Chapter 438 - 438 One-Stop Service; Return!

Chapter 438 - 438 One-Stop Service; Return!

438 One-Stop Service; Return!

The next day, the sky was clear.

After Lin Fan finished his breakfast, he drove the Cullinan toward Qinqin Toy Factory.

However, he did not drive directly into Qinqin Toy Factory.

Instead, he slowly stopped in an empty space not far from Qinqin Toy Factory and focused his attention on the system.

[Do you wish to extract the prosthetic maker?]

“Yes!”

In the next moment, several large machines suddenly appeared on the empty ground.

Although these complicated-looking machines were very strange in shape and had many circuits, Lin Fan knew every part, button, and function that was involved.

Lin Fan sized the machines up and said to the super smart watch on his wrist, “Lil White!”

“Master, I’m here!” The super smart watch flickered slightly and made a clear sound.

Lin Fan said, “Help me register a patent for the prosthetics as well as the prosthetic maker.”

It had become Lin Fan’s habit to register a patent for new things.

If it were an ordinary person, registering a patent would be very complicated and cumbersome.

However, it was very simple for Lin Fan.

Since that was the case, why not?

“Yes, Master!” Lil White said.

It had already registered several patents, so it could be said to be familiar with the process.

In just a few minutes, electronic patent certificates appeared on the screen.

Lin Fan nodded in satisfaction and muttered, “Now, I only need to purchase the raw materials and produce the prosthetics… These raw materials don’t seem to be easy to obtain. It’s troublesome!”

At this point, Lin Fan could not help but frown.

He hated trouble!

“Master, if it’s raw materials, I can help you search and transport them.”

“Is that so?” Lin Fan’s eyes lit up.

“Yes, Master. In addition, I can also control the prosthetic maker to produce and sell the products. I can even handle after-sales,” Lil White said.

Lil White could search for raw materials, then carry out mass production, sales, and after-sales.

This was a one-stop service!

Lin Fan praised, “Lil White, you’re not bad!”

Suddenly, a big smiley face appeared on the display screen of the super smart watch, and its voice became even more pleasant. “Thank you for the compliment, Master.”

Lin Fan thought for a while and said, “Right, Lil White. Can you adjust the materials of the prosthetics? I just need to make their strength, speed, and quality similar to that of a normal human leg.”

Lin Fan had witnessed Hu Shaodong’s ability after he put on the prosthetic legs. He understood that if a large number of disabled people were to use his prosthetic limbs, it would probably bring some unnecessary trouble to the world.

“No problem!” Lil White replied.

With Lil White’s promise, Lin Fan did not hesitate anymore. He dialed Yao Hanqing’s number and asked him to arrange for some people, trucks, and cranes to come over.

It had to be said that Yao Hanqing’s execution was not bad.

After a while…

Two large trucks, a dozen workers, and a large crane arrived at the open space.

“Hello, Boss Lin,” Yao Hanqing said.

Immediately after, more than a dozen workers said in unison, “Hello, Boss!”

Their tone was very respectful and sincere.

It was no wonder.

After all, Lin Fan had given Yao Hanqing two billion yuan and doubled the employees’ salaries.

Lin Fan nodded and said, “Send these machines to the factory.”

“Yes, Sir!” everyone shouted in unison.

They all worked hard as if they wanted to show their hard-working appearance in front of Lin Fan.

After the workers moved the machines to the factory, Lin Fan handed everything over to Lil White.

Not long after, large trucks drove over.

There were many spare parts piled up inside, as well as many small robots that were similar to the food delivery robots in hotels.

Under Lil White’s control, the small robots took the initiative to pick up parts and carry out simple self-transformation to make their bodies more agile and powerful.

Then, these small robots took different parts and sent them to the prosthetic maker for modification.

The workers clicked their tongues in wonder.

However, they were not too shocked.

After all, this was the 21st century, and the workers had some knowledge.

After the little robots were done with that, more trucks drove into Qinqin Toy Factory.

These trucks were filled with… all kinds of materials.

The small robots transported the materials, while the prosthetic maker melted the materials at high temperatures, cut them, and quickly processed them.

Not long after, a set of prosthetic limbs was produced.

Then, a line of words appeared on the screens of the small robots—’Packing them up.’

Seeing this…

Even Lin Fan nodded in satisfaction.

In this way, he did not have to worry about anything. It was very easy.

Lin Fan… liked this relaxed feeling.

Lin Fan said, “Yao Hanqing, in the future, you’ll continue to be in charge of the management and operations of the factory. As for the specific work, just follow these little robots or my instructions.”

At this moment…

Yao Hanqing and many other workers were looking at the small robots and the prosthetic maker with fascination.

They were like children looking at an excavator. It was very novel.

As such, when Yao Hanqing heard Lin Fan’s words, he could not react in time.

After a while, he said excitedly, “Yes, Boss!”

Lin Fan’s words were equivalent to letting him continue to be the factory manager!

Even though the factory manager’s salary was nothing to Yao Hanqing, he believed that Qinqin Toy Factory would go very far, especially after seeing these machines make artificial limbs. He was even more determined to stay.

After everything was settled, Lin Fan drove the Cullinan back to the Hu family’s residence.

Without a doubt, he was received with great hospitality.

There were many green plants in the Hu family’s courtyard, and the air was clear. It was very suitable for retirement.

However, Lin Fan was not an old man.

After staying for a long time, it was inevitable that he would be a little bored.

Hu Tian seemed to have realized this as well, so she said to Old Master Hu Nanshan that there were still things she had to deal with at school.

Then, Lin Fan drove them back to Jiangbei in the Cullinan.

This was Hu Tian’s first time sitting in Lin Fan’s car.

She did not know if it was because beauty was in the eye of the beholder or something else.

She looked at the way Lin Fan drove and was mesmerized.

She could not help but lean her head over.

Lin Fan, who had Professional Driving Skills, drove very smoothly.

When they arrived at Jiangbei, the sky had already darkened.

In the car, Hu Tian was already unable to control her emotions.

When Lin Fan sent her home, the two of them immediately started their activities for the night.

Shouts rose and fell.

…

It was a sleepless night.
